description: An open React design system and component library for AI products, with scoped styles, design tokens and component usage contracts.
rules: Check the Frame catalog and reuse published components before creating new UI; install with npx shadcn@latest add @frame/<slug>.
Import the installed frame.css once and wrap Frame content in an element with className="frame-root"; add dark to the wrapper or an ancestor for dark mode.
Use Frame token color classes and type-* typography tiers; do not use raw colors, Tailwind alpha modifiers on tokens or raw text sizes.
Use lucide-react icons and named accessible controls; preserve focus indicators and mobile touch targets of at least 44 pixels.
Follow each component usage contract. Frame components render UI and callbacks; the host application owns model calls, persistence and agent execution.
